bds.lede: WASHINGTON (AP) — Kilmar Abrego Garcia, a Salvadoran national who fought his mistaken deportation, left the U.S. voluntarily for Spain on Tuesday, officials and his attorneys said, in what could
rows: His deportation to El Salvador and return to the US became a flash point in the debate over President Donald Trump's immigration agenda.
Kilmar Abrego Garcia, the El Salvador native who was mistakenly deported last year, left the U.S. for Spain on Tuesday, the Department of Homeland Security confirmed.
US Senator Chris Van Hollen hails Kilmar Abrego Garcia's safe departure to Spain as a 'free man'.

WASHINGTON (AP) — Kilmar Abrego Garcia , a Salvadoran national mistakenly deported as part of the Trump administration's immigration crackdown, was leaving the U.S. voluntarily for Spain on Tuesday, according to a person familiar with the matter.
Kilmar Ábrego García voluntarily left the United States for Spain on Tuesday to avoid forced deportation, according to DHS, capping a months-long legal battle with ICE.
He had been ordered to leave the United States by Tuesday, a U.S. official said.
